name: ImageLibrary
description: A media manager: search, switch between grid and list, select one or many assets, upload, and inspect an asset in a details panel with editable alt text. Livewire only (D-003): it uploads through Livewire and syncs with the WithMediaSync trait; React and Vue use media-library's MediaModal and MediaGrid.

livewire.name: image-library
capabilities: wire:model names the uploads property and wire:library the library collection, as the WithMediaSync trait expects: uploads, replace, crop (with Cropper.js loaded), remove and drag-to-reorder (with SortableJS loaded) call its methods
Alt text edits set <library>.<key>.alt on the component
The 2.x preview collection still works as assets, and the 2.x *Text props as the labels

props.name: assets
props.description: The assets: { id, src, name, alt, size, width, height, type }. Livewire also takes a WithMediaSync library collection ({ uuid, url, … }) through preview.

props.name: view
props.description: Thumbnails in a grid, or rows with the name and metadata. The toolbar switches it. Emitted as data-view.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Whether one or many assets can be selected.

props.name: accept
props.description: The file types uploads accept, as the file input's accept.

props.name: droppable
props.description: Files dropped on the library upload, with an overlay while they're dragged over it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the library's listbox. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: cropConfig
props.description: Cropper.js options for the crop dialog, merged over the defaults.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { toolbar: '…', details: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The library: the main column and the details panel.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The toolbar, selection bar, progress, grid and hint.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: Search, the view switch and the upload button.

parts.name: search
parts.description: Holds the search Input, which filters assets by name as you type.

parts.name: spacer
parts.description: Pushes the view switch and upload to the end.

parts.name: view
parts.description: The grid and list buttons (aria-pressed).

parts.name: bulk
parts.description: The selection bar while assets are selected: select all, the count (announced) and actions.

parts.name: count
parts.description: "2 selected": a polite live region.

parts.name: progress
parts.description: Upload progress.

parts.name: grid
parts.description: The assets: role listbox, aria-multiselectable with multiple, one option in the Tab order.

parts.name: asset
parts.description: An asset: role option with aria-selected, named by its file name.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: The asset's image, or a file icon.

parts.name: check
parts.description: The selection box over the thumbnail (decorative: the option carries the state).

parts.name: type
parts.description: The file type badge on files that aren't images.

parts.name: name
parts.description: The file name, truncated.

parts.name: meta
parts.description: Size and dimensions.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Shown when there are no assets, or none match the search.

parts.name: hint
parts.description: The hint.

parts.name: error
parts.description: A validation error for the library.

parts.name: details
parts.description: The details panel for the active asset: preview, title, alt text, metadata and actions. The spec calls it the details panel.

parts.name: preview
parts.description: The active asset, contained.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The active asset's name.

parts.name: metadata
parts.description: Dimensions, size and type.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Insert, replace, crop and remove.

parts.name: dropzone
parts.description: The overlay while files are dragged over a droppable library.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: The selected assets changed. Livewire listens with x-on:selection-change or wire:model on a property through $wire.set in the listener.

events.name: insert
events.description: Insert was pressed with assets selected (the active one when none are).

keyboard.action: Moves into the listbox, to the active asset, then on to the details panel.
Move to the next or previous asset. They follow the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft moves to the next asset.
Move a row down or up in the grid, one asset in the list.
Move to the first or last asset.
Selects or deselects the focused asset.
Selects every asset shown, with multiple.

requirements: The grid is a listbox with aria-multiselectable; each asset is an option with aria-selected, named by its file name.
Only the active asset is in the Tab order (roving tabindex); the focus ring shows on its thumbnail.
The selection bar's count is a polite live region, so changes are announced.
Alt text is editable in the details panel and labelled; images without it are flagged there.
Removing assets asks for confirmation first.
Every icon-only button has a translatable accessible name.
Selection is shown by a ring and a checked box, not by color alone.
Arrow keys follow the text direction: in RTL ArrowLeft moves to the next asset.
